test_name: Contingency Planning - CP-10 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Data-Exchange-060
Primary NIST family: Contingency Planning (CP); evidence focus: CP-10.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: a recovery runbook was tested successfully but one screenshot artifact is missing from the evidence package. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
